accepted_answers: Centerville no longer exists as an independent municipality; it merged with Middleton in 1837 to form Cuba.
The population figures cited in the documents (1,294 in D1S2 and 5,000 in D2S2/D2S8) refer to Cuba, Illinois, not Centerville.
Centerville was one of two rival towns that merged to create Cuba, meaning it has no current separate population.
